title: More Perspectives, Stronger Signals: Multi-Perspective Enhancement and Progressive Fusion for Multimodal Entity Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.29139v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning effective multimodal entity representations is fundamental for reasoning tasks such as multimodal knowledge graph completion (MMKGC). However, existing methods often suffer from semantic over-smoothing within modalities and ineffective noise filtration across modalities, particularly under sparse or ambiguous conditions. To overcome these limitations, we propose PrismF, a unified framework that synergizes multi-perspective enhancement with progressive fusion to extract stronger signals from diverse inputs. PrismF enhances fine-grained intra-modal semantics through a multi-perspective mechanism that decomposes each modality into complementary views and constrains them with a decoupling loss to reduce representation collapse. translated_title: 更多视角，更强信号：面向多模态实体表示学习的多视角增强与渐进融合方法
translated_abstract: 学习有效的多模态实体表示是多模态知识图谱补全（MMKGC）等推理任务的基础。然而，现有方法常常受到模态内语义过度平滑以及跨模态噪声过滤效果不佳的困扰，尤其是在数据稀疏或语义模糊的条件下。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了PrismF，这是一个将多视角增强与渐进融合相结合的统一框架，能够从多样化输入中提取更强的信号。PrismF通过多视角机制增强细粒度的模态内语义，该机制将每个模态分解为互补的多个视图，并利用解耦损失对其进行约束，以减少表示坍缩问题。此外，它还通过渐进融合策略改进跨模态整合，该策略能够动态校准模态间的交互，使模型在强调信息性信号的同时抑制（噪声）……
tldr: 提出PrismF框架，通过将各模态分解为互补视图并结合解耦损失进行多视角增强，同时采用渐进融合策略动态校准模态间交互，有效缓解语义过度平滑与噪声干扰，提升多模态知识图谱补全的实体表示质量。
en_tdlr: PrismF enhances multimodal entity representation learning by decomposing each modality into complementary views with a decoupling loss and progressively fusing modalities through dynamic cross-modal calibration, mitigating semantic over-smoothing and noise to strengthen multimodal knowledge graph completion.
